title: The MapReduce Model
lines: Episode 2: the MapReduce model.
第 2 集：MapReduce 模型。
Episode 2: the Map Reduce model.
Last time, mrsequential put every pair from eight books into one slice in memory.
上一集，mrsequential 把八本书的所有词对放进了内存里的同一个切片。
Last time, M R sequential put every pair from eight books into one slice in memory.
On many machines there is no "one slice": each machine has only its own memory.
换成很多台机器，就没有“同一个切片”了：每台机器只有自己的内存。
Today: how the pairs are cut up so many machines can share the work.
今天讲：词对怎么切开，让很多台机器分着做。

title: The Whole Idea First
visual: A small copy of the page sits in a corner of every later scene, the current part lit (the stop strip).
lines: Here is the whole episode in two sentences.
先用两句话说完这一集。
Every pair from book X goes into file mr-X-Y, where Y is the word's hash, mod 10.
第 X 本书的每个词对，都进文件 mr-X-Y；Y 是这个词的哈希值对 10 取余。
Every pair from book X goes into file M R X Y, where Y is the word's hash, mod 10.
When every book is done, reducer Y reads column Y: every copy of its words, and nobody else's.
等所有书都做完，第 Y 个 reducer 读第 Y 列：它那些词的全部副本，别人的一个也没有。
Now the page, top to bottom. A: eight books, so eight map tasks, one row each.
下面是这张图，从上往下。A：八本书，就是八个 map 任务，一本一行。
B: Map turns a book into pairs, one per word: the word and "1".
B：Map 把一本书变成词对，每个词一对：这个词，和 "1"。
B: Map turns a book into pairs, one per word: the word and 1.
C: each pair picks its column with ihash, mod 10, and is appended to mr-X-Y.
C：每个词对用 ihash 对 10 取余选出它的列，追加进 mr-X-Y。
C: each pair picks its column with I hash, mod 10, and is appended to M R X Y.
D: a gate. Reduce may start only when all eight map tasks have finished.
D：一道闸。所有八个 map 任务都完成，reduce 才能开始。
E: reducer Y reads its column, sorts it, groups equal words, and writes mr-out-Y.
E：第 Y 个 reducer 读它那一列，排序，把相同的词归到一起，写出 mr-out-Y。
E: reducer Y reads its column, sorts it, groups equal words, and writes M R out Y.
We'll follow one word down this page: "of". Its path will light up as we go.
我们跟着一个词 "of" 从上走到下。它走过的地方会一路亮起来。
We'll follow one word down this page: of. Its path will light up as we go.

title: The Comment That Starts It
lines: mrsequential admits the difference in a comment, right after the map loop.
mrsequential 在 map 循环后面的注释里自己说了区别。
The sequential version admits the difference in a comment, right after the map loop.
All the intermediate data sits in one place, rather than being partitioned into N by M buckets.
所有中间数据都放在一个地方，而不是分进 N×M 个桶。
All the intermediate data sits in one place, rather than being partitioned into N by M buckets.
src/main/mrsequential.go:53–57
"Intermediate data" means the pairs: Map's output, before Reduce has seen them.
“中间数据”就是那些词对：Map 的输出，还没交给 Reduce 的东西。
So the pairs are cut twice: once by which book they came from, once by which bucket they go to.
所以词对要切两刀：按来自哪本书切一次，按去哪个桶再切一次。

title: Where M and R Come From
zh: M 和 R 从哪来
visual: Corner: part A. The grid is the page's part A–C drawn large.
lines: The first cut is free: one map task per input file. Eight books, so M is 8.
第一刀是现成的：每个输入文件一个 map 任务。八本书，M 就是 8。
A "task" is one piece of work a machine can be handed on its own.
“任务”就是能单独交给一台机器去做的一份活。
A task is one piece of work a machine can be handed on its own.
The second number is nReduce, the number of reduce tasks. Where does it come from?
第二个数是 nReduce，也就是 reduce 任务的个数。它从哪来？
The second number is n Reduce, the number of reduce tasks. Where does it come from?
mrcoordinator.go hard-codes it: MakeCoordinator gets 10, every run.
mrcoordinator.go 写死了：每次都给 MakeCoordinator 传 10。
The coordinator launcher hard-codes it: Make Coordinator gets ten, every run.
src/main/mrcoordinator.go:23
Eight rows times ten columns: eighty intermediate files.
八行乘十列：八十个中间文件。
The lab suggests naming them mr-X-Y: X is the map task, Y is the reduce bucket.
Lab 建议把它们命名为 mr-X-Y：X 是 map 任务，Y 是 reduce 桶。
The lab suggests naming them M R, X, Y: X is the map task, Y is the reduce bucket.

title: A Rule That Picks a Bucket
visual: Corner: part C. Label 玩具例子 / toy. Six word cards, three buckets.
lines: Each pair must land in exactly one bucket. We need a rule. Let's try one on a toy.
每个词对必须进恰好一个桶。我们需要一条规则，先拿玩具例子试试。
Six words, three buckets: sea, see, sun, sky, sand, cat.
六个词，三个桶：sea、see、sun、sky、sand、cat。
Rule one: by first letter. a–h go to bucket 0, i–r to 1, s–z to 2.
规则一：按首字母。a 到 h 进 0 号桶，i 到 r 进 1 号，s 到 z 进 2 号。
Rule one: by first letter. A to H go to bucket 0, I to R to 1, S to Z to 2.
How full is each bucket?
每个桶有多满？
pause
Bucket 2 gets five words, bucket 0 gets one, bucket 1 gets none.
2 号桶五个词，0 号桶一个，1 号桶一个都没有。
Real books do the same. Across all eight, 2,691 distinct words start with s, and only 12 with z.
真实的书也一样。八本书里，s 开头的不同单词有 2,691 个，z 开头的只有 12 个。
data.py: distinct words by first letter (mrsequential output)
Rule two, still a toy: add up the letters' places in the alphabet, a is 1, z is 26.
规则二，还是玩具：把字母在字母表里的位置加起来，a 是 1，z 是 26。
sea is 19 plus 5 plus 1: 25. Mod 3 leaves 1, so bucket 1.
sea 是 19 加 5 加 1：25。对 3 取余剩 1，进 1 号桶。
toy.py
Do all six and each bucket gets exactly two words.
六个词都算完，每个桶正好两个词。
toy.py
The key part: sea gives 25 whichever book it came from. Same word, same bucket, every time.
关键在这里：不管 sea 来自哪本书，算出来都是 25。同一个词，永远进同一个桶。
A rule like that is a hash function: it scrambles the input, but never changes its answer.
这样的规则就叫哈希函数：把输入打乱，但答案永远不变。

title: ihash, by Hand
visual: Corner: part C. Picture left (bytes going in), code right.
lines: The real rule is ihash, a hash function given to you in worker.go.
真正的规则是 ihash，worker.go 里发给你的哈希函数。
The real rule is I hash, a hash function given to you in worker dot go.
It's FNV-1a: start from a fixed 32-bit number, then take the word one byte at a time.
它是 FNV-1a：从一个固定的 32 位数开始，然后逐字节处理这个词。
It's F N V one A: start from a fixed thirty-two bit number, then take the word one byte at a time.
For each byte: XOR it in, which flips the bits where the byte has a 1.
每个字节：先异或进去，也就是在这个字节为 1 的位上把位翻过来。
Then multiply by a fixed prime, and keep only the low 32 bits.
再乘一个固定的质数，只保留低 32 位。
"o" is 0x6f. XOR, multiply: 0xea0c329e.
"o" 是 0x6f。异或、相乘：得到 0xea0c329e。
The letter o is hex six F. X O R, multiply: and we get hex E A zero C three two nine E.
"f" is 0x66. XOR, multiply: 0x69343c68, which is 1,765,031,016.
The letter f is hex six six. X O R, multiply: one billion, seven hundred sixty-five million.
The mask clears the top bit, so the result is never negative. Here it changes nothing.
掩码把最高位清零，结果就不会是负数。这里它没改变任何东西。
Mod 10 gives 6. "of" goes to bucket 6.
对 10 取余得 6。"of" 进 6 号桶。
Mod ten gives six. The word of goes to bucket six.
Here is the same thing in worker.go: New32a is FNV-1a, and the comment says to take it mod NReduce.
worker.go 里是同一件事：New32a 就是 FNV-1a，注释写着要对 NReduce 取余。
Here is the same thing in worker dot go: New thirty-two A is F N V one A, and the comment says to take it mod n Reduce.
src/mr/worker.go:16–22
And the real run agrees: "of" lands in bucket 6.
真实运行也一样："of" 落在 6 号桶。
And the real run agrees: of lands in bucket six.

title: Same Word, Same Column
lines: Like the toy, ihash depends only on the word, not on the book or the machine.
和玩具例子一样，ihash 只看这个词，不管它来自哪本书、哪台机器。
Like the toy, I hash depends only on the word, not on the book or the machine.
"of" appears in all eight books. How many intermediate files hold it?
"of" 八本书里都有。有几个中间文件装着它？
The word of appears in all eight books. How many intermediate files hold it?
pause
Eight: mr-0-6 through mr-7-6. One cell in every row, all in column 6.
八个：从 mr-0-6 到 mr-7-6。每一行一格，全在第 6 列。
Eight: one cell in every row, all in column six.
Frankenstein's cell has 2,746 of them. Sherlock Holmes's has 2,734. Being Earnest's has 485.
《弗兰肯斯坦》那格有 2,746 个，《福尔摩斯》那格有 2,734 个，《认真的重要》那格有 485 个。
And no other column holds a single "of".
其他列一个 "of" 都没有。
And no other column holds a single of.

title: So Far, on the Page
visual: Back to the full framework page. "of"'s path lit through A, B, C; D and E still dim.
lines: So far, on our page: A, rows are map tasks, one per book.
到目前为止，在这张图上：A，行是 map 任务，一本书一行。
B and C: each pair's word, hashed mod 10, picks its column.
B 和 C：每个词对的词，哈希后对 10 取余，选出它的列。
"of" has reached column 6, in eight files. Next comes the gate, D.
"of" 已经到了第 6 列，分在八个文件里。下一步是闸门 D。
of has reached column 6, in eight files. Next comes the gate, D.

title: The Gate: Reduce Must Wait
visual: Corner: part D. (Moved here from near the end, so the stops follow run order.)
lines: Reducer 6 wants to start. Map task 7, Tom Sawyer, is still running. Can it?
6 号 reducer 想开始了，map 任务 7《汤姆·索亚》还在跑。它能开始吗？
pause
No. Column 6 is missing its last file, so its count for "of" would be 1,565 short.
不能。第 6 列还缺最后一个文件，"of" 的次数会少 1,565。
No. Column six is missing its last file, so its count for of would be fifteen hundred short.
data.py: track.of[7] (Tom Sawyer)
So reduce starts only after every map task has finished. The lab says the same.
所以 reduce 要等所有 map 任务都完成才开始。Lab 也是这么要求的。
Who checks this gate, and how, is the coordinator's job: episode 3.
谁来守这道闸、怎么守，是协调者的事：第 3 集讲。

title: Sort, Then Group
visual: Corner: part E. Label 玩具例子 / toy. Five pair cards.
lines: Before the real column, one toy. Five pairs: of, a, of, the, a.
读真实的列之前，先看一个玩具例子。五个词对：of、a、of、the、a。
Sort them by word: a, a, of, of, the. Equal words now sit next to each other.
按词排序：a、a、of、of、the。相同的词现在挨在一起了。
toy.py
Walk the list and cut it where the word changes: three runs.
沿着列表走，词一变就切一刀：三段。
Each run goes to Reduce once. wc.go's Reduce just counts: a 2, of 2, the 1.
每一段交给 Reduce 一次。wc.go 的 Reduce 只是数个数：a 2、of 2、the 1。
Each run goes to Reduce once. W C dot go's Reduce just counts: a 2, of 2, the 1.
toy.py, src/mrapps/wc.go Reduce

title: Reduce Reads a Column
visual: Corner: part E. Picture left, `mrsequential.go:59–84` right, the same toy steps lit.
lines: Now for real. Reducer 6 reads its column: eight files, mr-0-6 through mr-7-6.
现在来真的。6 号 reducer 读它那一列：八个文件，mr-0-6 到 mr-7-6。
Now for real. Reducer 6 reads its column: eight files, M R 0 6 through M R 7 6.
That's 105,743 pairs, with every "of" somewhere among them.
一共 105,743 个词对，所有的 "of" 都在里面。
That's a hundred and five thousand pairs, with every of somewhere among them.
From here it's exactly the toy, and exactly mrsequential: sort by key.
从这里开始就和玩具例子、和 mrsequential 一模一样：按键排序。
From here it's exactly the toy, and exactly M R sequential: sort by key.
src/main/mrsequential.go:59
The 13,536 "of" pairs now sit together. Walk each run of equal keys and call Reduce.
13,536 个 "of" 挨在了一起。走过每一段相同的键，调用 Reduce。
The 13,536 of pairs now sit together. Walk each run of equal keys and call Reduce.
src/main/mrsequential.go:68–84
The lab says you may reuse this sorting and output code from mrsequential.
Lab 说可以直接复用 mrsequential 里的排序和输出代码。
The lab says you may reuse this sorting and output code from the sequential version.
Reducer 6 writes mr-out-6. One of its lines: of 13536. "of" has reached the bottom of the page.
6 号 reducer 写出 mr-out-6，其中一行：of 13536。"of" 走到了这张图的最底下。
Reducer 6 writes M R out 6. One of its lines: of 13536. of has reached the bottom of the page.

title: The Real Run: 80 Files
lines: Here's a real run of this data path on the eight books, with nReduce set to 10.
这是这条数据路径在八本书上的真实运行，nReduce 设为 10。
Here's a real run of this data path on the eight books, with n Reduce set to ten.
It wrote exactly 80 intermediate files, and ten output files.
它正好写了 80 个中间文件和 10 个输出文件。
Distinct words per bucket: between 2,173 and 2,251. ihash spreads the words evenly.
每个桶的不同单词数：2,173 到 2,251 之间。ihash 把词分得很均匀。
Distinct words per bucket: between 2,173 and 2,251. I hash spreads the words evenly.
But pairs per bucket range from 39,508 to 105,743. Why so uneven?
但每个桶的词对数从 39,508 到 105,743。为什么差这么多？
But pairs per bucket range from thirty-nine thousand to a hundred and five thousand. Why so uneven?
pause
Because a few words are huge. Bucket 6 holds "of", 13,536 pairs. Bucket 2 holds "the", 29,748.
因为少数几个词特别多。6 号桶有 "of"，13,536 个；2 号桶有 "the"，29,748 个。
Because a few words are huge. Bucket six holds of, thirteen thousand pairs. Bucket two holds the, almost thirty thousand.
A hash balances words, not work. One very common word always lands on one reducer.
哈希平衡的是词，不是工作量。一个特别常见的词，总是落在同一个 reducer 上。

title: How the Test Judges It
lines: How does Lab 1 know your buckets are right? Look at TestWc in mr_test.go.
Lab 1 怎么知道你分桶分对了？看 mr_test.go 里的 TestWc。
How does Lab 1 know your buckets are right? Look at Test W C in the M R test file.
src/mr/mr_test.go:9–23
First, mkCorrectOutput runs mrsequential on the same books and sorts its output.
先是 mkCorrectOutput：在同样的书上跑 mrsequential，把输出排序。
First, make correct output runs the sequential version on the same books and sorts its output.
Then mergeOutput sorts all your mr-out files together into one file.
然后 mergeOutput 把你所有的 mr-out 文件合在一起排序。
Then merge output sorts all your output files together into one file.
And runCmp compares the two, byte for byte. Our real run: identical.
最后 runCmp 把两个文件逐字节比较。我们的真实运行：完全相同。
And run compare compares the two, byte for byte. Our real run: identical.
Suppose "of" ended up in two buckets. What happens?
假如 "of" 进了两个桶，会怎样？
Suppose of ended up in two buckets. What happens?
pause
Two lines start with "of", each with part of the count. cmp finds the difference, and the test fails.
会有两行以 "of" 开头，各带一部分次数。cmp 找到不同，测试失败。
Two lines start with of, each with part of the count. C M P finds the difference, and the test fails.

title: What This Episode Skipped
lines: We ran the whole page in one process, with nothing going wrong.
我们是在一个进程里跑完整张图的，什么错都没出。
Who hands each row and column to a worker, and what happens when a worker dies halfway?
谁把每一行、每一列派给 worker？worker 做到一半死了怎么办？
And how do you stop a half-written mr-X-Y from being read? That's episode 3.
怎么防止别人读到写了一半的 mr-X-Y？这些是第 3 集。
And how do you stop a half-written file from being read? That's episode 3.
How the pairs are written inside each file is your choice. The lab suggests JSON, one pair at a time.
每个文件里词对怎么写由你决定。Lab 建议用 JSON，一次写一个。
How the pairs are written inside each file is your choice. The lab suggests Jason, one pair at a time.

title: Recap, on the Page
visual: The full framework page, "of"'s whole path lit. Each takeaway lights its part.
lines: One: M map tasks times R reduce buckets. Eight times ten, eighty files.
一：M 个 map 任务乘 R 个 reduce 桶。八乘十，八十个文件。
Two: ihash mod nReduce picks the column, so every copy of a word meets in one reducer.
二：ihash 对 nReduce 取余决定列，同一个词的所有副本会在同一个 reducer 汇合。
Two: I hash mod n Reduce picks the column, so every copy of a word meets in one reducer.
Three: reduce reads a whole column, so it waits at the gate for every map task.
三：reduce 读一整列，所以要在闸门前等所有 map 任务完成。

title: Your Turn
lines: Your turn: hash "the" by hand. Three bytes: 0x74, 0x68, 0x65.
轮到你：手算 "the" 的哈希。三个字节：0x74、0x68、0x65。
Your turn: hash the word the, by hand. Three bytes: hex seven four, six eight, six five.
Which bucket does it go to? Careful with the mask this time.
它进几号桶？这次小心掩码。
Which bucket does it go to? Careful with the mask this time.
pause
The hash is 3,020,861,980. The mask clears the top bit: 873,378,332. Mod 10: bucket 2.
The hash is about three billion. The mask clears the top bit, leaving about eight hundred seventy-three million. Mod ten: bucket two.
And mr-out-2 says: the 29748. Next episode: the coordinator, crashes, and atomic rename.
mr-out-2 里写着：the 29748。下一集：协调者、崩溃和原子改名。
And output file two says: the, twenty-nine thousand seven hundred forty-eight. Next episode: the coordinator, crashes, and atomic rename.
